FY2016 – FY2025 (annual only; no quarterly columns — see note below)
As-reported P&L, EPS/share count, Adjusted EBITDA bridge
As-reported balance sheet, balance check, working-capital analytics

Mobility / Delivery / Freight (and legacy ATG / All Other) revenue and Adjusted EBITDA, tied to IS revenue

Gross Bookings, MAPCs, Trips and derived KPIs
Ratio and common-size analytics computed from metrics.md
FY2018-2019 revenue and cost of revenue were restated in the FY2020 10-K to reclassify certain Driver/Restaurant incentives as a reduction of revenue. This model uses the restated basis throughout.
Reportable segments changed from 5 (2018-2020, incl. ATG and All Other) to 4 (2019-2021, ATG divested) to 3 (Mobility/Delivery/Freight only, from FY2021 10-K onward, All Other phased out).
Country-level revenue disclosure added a separate United Kingdom line starting the FY2023 10-K; prior years' 'All other countries' figure includes the UK.
Operating lease right-of-use assets/liabilities first appear in FY2019 upon adoption of the new lease standard — not a data gap for FY2016-2018.
Uber began separately disclosing Interest income (previously netted within Other income (expense)) starting the FY2025 10-K, with FY2023 restated on a comparable basis.
Omitted — the curated Tier-1 source (financial_input.json) contains only annual data; no quarterly time series was available to build a consistent quarterly block.

Tier 1: data/curated financial_input.json (curated aggregates). Tier 2: SEC 10-K/10-Q source HTML (as-reported detail). Tier 3: sec-cleaned S-1/press releases (supplementary). Tier 4: metrics.md (derived ratios). See Sources sheet for the full table-level bibliography.
